runtime: adobe/aem-boilerplate 1.3.0 — scripts/aem.js vendored (Copyright 2026 build: sampleRUM to https://ot.aem.live, trusted-types-aware), scripts/scripts.js functionally stock (trusted-types default policy, decorateMain = decorateIcons > buildAutoBlocks > decorateSections > decorateBlocks > decorateButtons, loadEager/loadLazy/loadDelayed)
blockWrapperClass: {block}-wrapper (added to the block's parent div by decorateBlock); the section also receives {block}-container; the block itself gets .block + data-block-name + data-block-status; non-block section content is grouped under div.default-content-wrapper
fragmentScriptPolicy: blocks/fragment/fragment.js is the only cross-block import; it imports decorateMain from /scripts/scripts.js (import/no-cycle disabled) and loadSections from /scripts/aem.js. loadFragment(path) fetches `${path}.plain.html` for root-relative paths only, returns null on a non-OK response, otherwise a decorated and loaded <main>. buildAutoBlocks also inlines any `a[href*="/fragments/"]` link by replacing its parent with the fragment's children.
emptySectionCollapse: decorateSections sets section.style.display = 'none' on every section until loadSection flips it back (display: null); styles.css hides `main .section:empty`. An empty document decorates to one empty `.section` (no wrappers), which is why header/footer test for `:scope > div > *` rather than firstElementChild.
notes: Consent: loadDelayed() dynamic-imports scripts/consent-check.js on every page load; it reads ?consent=, defaults to declined, dispatches a `consent.update` CustomEvent and only then imports scripts/consented.js, which is a comment-only stub. It injects no UI, no DOM and no external request on this site, so it was left stock. Fonts: loadFonts() still loads styles/fonts.css (desktop or sessionStorage flag) — the file is now a one-line comment, no @font-face, no preload. Widget auto-block: links to /widgets/ become a `widget` block (blocks/widget kept). Demo blocks cards/columns/hero were removed (unused by the replica; they referenced the retired --background-color token). Links keep UA defaults: styles.css defines no a/button rules, so decorateButtons' classes paint nothing.
